title: Smoky Tofu Stir Fry
description: A German-inspired stir fry made with smoky tofu, perfect for a quick and easy meal. This dish combines the flavors of Germany with the convenience of a stir fry.

ingredients.name: stir fry vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, onions)

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add stir fry vegetables and cook until tender.
Add smoky tofu and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add silken tofu and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in german mustard and paprika.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
